messages:
julia.ops: Heads up — Deploybot queued schema migration 'customer_flags_jsonb' for Tue 03:00-04:00 PDT. This is add jsonb col + backfill for active customers. Need lock strategy, rate cap, and a release-note blurb. @deploybot will run canary first.
raj.eng: prefer a staged backfill (pid-range shards) with a tight rate cap. avoid long table locks. recommend `backfill_batch_size=1000` and pause-on-retry.
ana-sre: tagging @ana-sre for maintenance window. We'll reserve the 03:00-04:00 slot and provision a read-replica snaphost for validation. set alert on replica-lag>30s. :warning:
matt-db: proposed plan: add nullable `customer_flags jsonb`, deploy code change, then run backfill job in parallel sharded by `mod(id, 8)`. SQL dry-run in staging first. SQL snippet for the non-blocking add:
```sql
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN customer_flags jsonb;
-- backfill example (id range chunk)
UPDATE customers SET customer_flags = '{}' WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 100000;
```
sophia-product: draft release note: "Adds structured customer flags to enable per-customer feature routing; rollout is gradual and safe, no service downtime expected." Can include sample migration note.
deploybot: Canary initiated on us-west2 (3 instances). Canary run: schema add + single shard backfill. Monitoring hook: @ana-sre, @matt-db.
julia.ops: Good. Escape hatch: if backfill causing >5% error or replica lag >45s, abort backfill and fall back to incremental retry. Set `rollback_mode=nonblocking` so code can handle missing jsonb until backfill completes.
raj.eng: Also pin library version in release notes: `redwood-models v1.12.0` to avoid serializer mismatch. Add `migration_timeout=45m` to deploy config.
nana-sre: I'll add temporary rate-limiter at infra layer and watch for 429s. Will post a short runbook in the channel at 02:45 PDT.
matt-db: I will run a staging dry-run at 23:30 PDT tonight and post timing/row-rate data. If we see hotspots, we'll shrink batch size.
sophia-product: I'll add the short blurb to release notes and mention the monitoring page + rollback steps.
julia.ops: Ok locking plan: no table-level exclusive locks. Use single-column add (fast) then rely on backfill jobs. Confirming: canary -> staged waves (8 shards) -> full sweep. Anyone object?
raj.eng: LGTM from eng side. :thumbsup:
anа-sre: SRE ack, will monitor latency and replicas. Will also add a deploybot holdpoint at 03:10 to check health before proceeding with remaining shards.
deploybot: Holdpoint created at 03:10. To continue run: `deploybot continue 1764123456` (ops only). To abort: `deploybot abort 1764123456`.
julia.ops: Great — I'll update the release notes and attach rollout checklist + quick rollback commands. Reminder: runbook will include `psql` query to resume/stop backfill and links to replica metrics.
matt-db: noted. also will capture sample reindex commands if we need to reindex jsonb ops.
sophia-product: added release-note entry + user-facing FAQ snippet.
julia.ops: Final: staging dry-run -> confirm rates -> proceed with canary at 03:00 -> holdpoint at 03:10 -> continue waves. If any blocker, we'll abort and follow rollback checklist. Thanks all. :rocket:
